allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed client hostnames or IP addresses permitted to connect to the POP password change service.

pam_service_name.description: Name of the PAM service configuration file (without .conf), used for authentication and password change.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., 'daemon', 'local0', 'local1').

chroot.description: Run the server inside a chroot jail for security (recommended).

chroot_dir.description: Directory to use as the root of the chroot environment (if chroot is enabled).

port.description: TCP port to listen on (standard POP password change port is 106). Set to 0 to disable direct listening (e.g., for inetd/xinetd).

pid_file.description: Full path to write the process PID file. Leave empty or unset to disable PID file creation.

password_change_command.description: Optional command to run instead of using PAM for password changes (e.g., for legacy compatibility).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections. 0 means unlimited.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which the connection is closed.
